svg.desc: Every record with its status and confirmation markers at G9. Solid blue edges are dependencies taken from each record's "Depends on" line, drawn where both records sit in the same row of tiles (every tile lists its full line); the grey edge is the one supersession; red dashed edges are the reversals in effect (ToO §8.3) and ADR-0040's.

Tile colour is status: blue Accepted (genesis), red Accepted with a confirmation marker (C1–C4, ADR-0029 §4), amber Proposed, grey superseded, tombstone or reserved.
"bootstrap set": ADR-0024 to 0027, which cannot carry a marker (ADR-0029 §4).
"§1–§5, §7, §8": ratified in part; §6 stays Proposed (ADR-0022, ADR-0042).
40 Accepted (18 + 22 confirmation-required), 2 in part · 3 Proposed · 1 superseded · 1 tombstone · 1 reserved: 45 files, numbered to 0046, as at G8.
No new record at G9. The one ratification since G8 is Batch 26, ADR-0046 E1, an erratum. Four pending amendments, up from one: 0026 A1 (R8); 0033 A7 and A8; 0034 A2
(C2, C4), marked inline and not applied (G9 §1.1, §6). The last record added is ADR-0046 (Batch 25, G8).
Reversals in effect (ToO §8.3), all by the author alone in genesis: 0008 by 0038 (superseded); 0017's ordering-primacy clause (supersession unwritten, G9 item 6); 0018's Reader
